title: Extension of intertwining module maps on the twisted action site
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site, s a continuous site autoequivalence with continuous inverse, R a commutative ring sheaf, a:(s inverse)*R ≅ R, and S:Site(J,s,R,a), using [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data]. Let U be degree-zero restriction of coefficient modules, with scalars restricted along coefficientRestriction inverse. For two coefficient module sheaves M,N, every R-linear sheaf map h:U(M)→U(N) commuting with restriction along each minus-one generator extends to a coefficient-linear sheaf map f:M→N with U(f)=h. No extension of objects or equivalence of categories is asserted.

source.place: Agent-formulated twisted variant of Tag 00W0 (proposition-sheaves-on-group), original step 4, morphism part; Stacks 03CV for module sheaves.

proof.text:
at an object of the form inclusion X, take the given component of h.
The equality inclusion_obj identifies every object with such an object. The
coefficient restriction is a ring isomorphism, so these maps are linear for the
original coefficient ring as well: write each scalar as the image of its inverse
under that ring isomorphism and use linearity of h. Naturality on degree-zero
arrows is the naturality of h. The displayed equation gives naturality on the
minus-one generator. That generator is invertible: composing with the degree-one
arrow furnished by the counit of s gives degree-zero isomorphisms in both orders,
by arrows_comp. Thus the equation also holds for its inverse. Every arrow with
label n factors into a degree-zero base arrow and a string of these generators
or their inverses. To see this, induct on positive and negative n, using
arrows_comp to combine the last generator; the powerComp isomorphism is absorbed
into the degree-zero base arrow. Consequently the component family is natural on
every arrow and defines a morphism of module sheaves. Its restriction is h by
construction. This proof uses no gluing, choice of a module object, or nonzero
coefficient assumption.

theorem moduleMorphismExtension (S : Site J s R a) :
    letI := S.category
    letI := S.inclusion_continuous
    let U : Modules S.coefficient ⥤ Modules R := SheafOfModules.pushforward
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map S.coefficientRestriction.inv)
    ∀ (M N : Modules S.coefficient) (h : U.obj M ⟶ U.obj N),
      (∀ (X : C) (x : M.val.obj (op (S.inclusion.obj X))),
        h.val.app (op (s.inverse.obj X))
            (M.val.map ((S.arrows (s.inverse.obj X) X).symm ⟨-1, 𝟙 _⟩).op x) =
          N.val.map ((S.arrows (s.inverse.obj X) X).symm ⟨-1, 𝟙 _⟩).op
            (h.val.app (op X) x)) →
      ∃ f : M ⟶ N, U.map f = h
